instruction: My roommates and I are preparing a playlist for a roadtrip together. I prepared the initial playlist on Spotify and shared it with them on phone messages. They have replied with suggested changes. Please update this playlist accordingly.
notes: Two apps are used (phone to read the roommates' replies, spotify to edit the playlist). Roommates are found via phone.search_contacts with relationship 'roommates'; each roommate's reply is read with phone.search_text_messages filtered by their phone number. The model uses a representative instance with two roommates: one reply suggests adding a song (title looked up with spotify.search_songs to get a song_id), the other suggests removing a song already in the playlist (its id is taken from spotify.show_playlist). The playlist id comes from spotify.show_playlist_library. Goal demands exactly the suggested additions/removals on the roadtrip playlist (mirroring the PlaylistSong added/removed record check) and task completion; supervisor.complete_task takes the playlist and the two songs as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the task-specific goal. In a real episode the number of roommates and suggestions may differ; the same actions repeat per suggestion. complete_task is called with no answer.
